name: "Monster" Avocado Toast with Hard-Boiled Egg, Bell Pepper, Carrot & Olives (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ red bell pepper
1 medium carrot

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and halve bell pepper crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Place on a plate.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the plate with the bell pepper.
Slice eggs crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the plate, along with drained olives, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (108 g) can sliced black olives

instructions.primary_message: Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh.

FOR YOUNGER KIDS: Place avocados in a medium bowl, add salt and pepper, then mash with a potato masher until smooth. Spread mashed avocado on toast. 

FOR OLDER KIDS: Slice avocados, arrange one half of an avocado on each slice of toast, and fan out. Let kids mash avocado into the toast, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Get the kids to decorate the toast with the bell pepper, grated carrot, sliced eggs, and olives to make monster faces, fun designs, or anything else that your imagination can come up with!
Divide avocado toast between plates and enjoy!
